answer: A payout is split so that 54% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The meadow schedule is applied in garden and harbor shows each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4650 identities would post 2779 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
